title.ru: БУДУЩЕЕ КАК ГРАНИЧНОЕ УСЛОВИЕ: хаос -> ограничения -> порядок -> доказательный путь TRUMP
title.en: FUTURE AS BOUNDARY CONDITION: chaos -> constraints -> order -> TRUMP proof path

purpose.ru: Преобразовать философскую интуицию 'будущее идёт навстречу, а хаос складывается в порядок' в строгую proof-search механику: целевое терминальное утверждение используется как граничное условие, его необходимые обязательства распространяются назад по цепи преобразований, затем вся цепь проигрывается вперёд с proof-carrying certificates. Случайные внешние находки допускаются как источники гипотез, но не как доказательства.

core_mechanism.name: FUTURE_BOUNDARY_BACKWARD_OBLIGATION_PROPAGATION
core_mechanism.backward_obligation_formula: O_k = REQUIREMENTS(G); O_i = WP(T_{i+1}, REL_{i+1}, O_{i+1})
core_mechanism.wp_note: WP is used in the generic sense of a weakest-precondition-like backward requirement operator: determine what must already be true before a transformation so that the downstream claim can remain valid.
core_mechanism.forward_replay_formula: CERTIFIED(G) only if FOR_ALL_i VERIFY(X_i, REL_{i+1}, C_{i+1}, O_i)=PASS and terminal verification=PASS

janus_duality.future_face: Start from the exact terminal theorem/solver claim and ask what certificates must exist immediately before it.
janus_duality.past_face: Replay from the actual originating instance and prove each required obligation with preserved provenance.
janus_duality.center: The present gate is where backward necessity meets forward evidence.

chaos_to_order_model.candidate_extractor: H(E_t) -> zero or more candidate mechanisms h
chaos_to_order_model.constraint_update: Omega_{t+1} = {h in Omega_t : h is compatible with newly certified constraints}
chaos_to_order_model.order_measure: Order is represented operationally by reduction of the viable hypothesis/certificate space, not by a claim that randomness vanished.
chaos_to_order_model.entropy_metaphor_boundary: A decrease in search uncertainty can be measured in specific formal models, but this artifact does not claim a universal physical entropy reduction caused by attention.
chaos_to_order_model.path_emergence: A path appears when successive certified constraints eliminate incompatible branches and leave a smaller set of viable continuations.

serendipity_to_signal_protocol.rule: Record the event or external cue before adapting the theory to it where practicable.
Translate the cue into a substrate-independent candidate operator, invariant, counterexample pattern or proof obligation.
Before testing on the target evidence, state at least one consequence that would be expected if the candidate is useful and at least one observation that would count against it.
Run the candidate against current TRUMP objects plus adversarial/negative controls where available.
Ask whether the candidate closes a previously open proof obligation, finds a smaller counterexample, reduces certified search space, or improves a verified complexity/correctness statement.
Promote only with certificate. Otherwise preserve as inspiration/failed hypothesis without contaminating the proof ledger.

anti_hindsight_bias_protocol.problem: Once an event is known, many stories can be invented that make it look inevitable.

everything_should_have_happened_translat.philosophical_mode: Treat the lived sequence as a path whose events may acquire meaning through later relations.
everything_should_have_happened_translat.trump_mode: Do not discard an encountered event solely because it originated outside the current mathematical plan; inspect whether it induces a testable relation to an open obligation.
everything_should_have_happened_translat.strict_boundary: TRUMP must never infer that an event was mathematically necessary merely because it happened.

connection_to_proof_carrying_relation.new_delta: The Future Boundary Engine tells TRUMP which obligations a relation must ultimately discharge by propagating terminal requirements backward.
connection_to_proof_carrying_relation.terminal_to_relation: G -> required fields/strength of REL_k -> ... -> required fields/strength of REL_1
connection_to_proof_carrying_relation.benefit: Avoid proving elegant local facts that cannot compose into the terminal claim.

connection_to_numeric_mnemonic.pi: At each edge, identify the exact invariant that must survive because the future boundary requires it.
connection_to_numeric_mnemonic.68: A relation whose forward side is certified but one or more future-required reverse/reconstruction obligations remain pending.
connection_to_numeric_mnemonic.69: All claim-scoped obligations required by the propagated terminal boundary are certified.
connection_to_numeric_mnemonic.67: The chain was promoted beyond what the propagated obligations and certificates justify.

new_fields.TERMINAL_CLAIM: Exact theorem/algorithmic statement we are trying to earn, not an inspirational slogan.
new_fields.O_BACKWARD: Set of obligations propagated backward from the terminal claim to the current gate.
new_fields.SURPRISE_HINTS: External/cross-domain events captured as hypotheses but excluded from proof authority until tested.
new_fields.PREDICTION_LEDGER: Pre-registered consequences and falsifiers for hints promoted beyond inspiration.

backward_questions_for_current_gate: If the final TRUMP claim were already correct, what must be true at the immediately preceding representation?
Which exact invariant must survive this transformation for the final claim to remain possible?
Which witness information must be recoverable at the source?
Which size/time bounds must compose rather than merely hold locally?
What is the weakest local certificate sufficient for the downstream proof?
Which current computation is irrelevant because no terminal obligation depends on it?
What minimal counterexample would prove that the required obligation cannot survive this edge?
forward_replay_questions: Is every backward-derived obligation explicitly discharged?
Can each certificate be verified independently at the correct source object?
Do the relations compose without hidden exponential reconstruction or metadata growth?
Does a counterexample invalidate only one local edge or the terminal claim itself?
Are empirical observations kept separate from asymptotic proofs?
Can the full chain be replayed from frozen inputs without relying on hindsight-only choices?

candidate_payoff.value_even_if_null: A clean negative result still identifies whether the obstacle is semantic preservation, reconstruction, composition, size, runtime or coverage.

falsification_tests.fail_condition: Cross-domain hints repeatedly fit only after results are known and generate no pre-test consequences.
Backward propagation does not eliminate irrelevant branches or clarify any proof obligation compared with baseline planning.
Local relations verify but their metadata/reconstruction/composition grows super-polynomially or loses required semantics.
falsification_tests.effect: Current fifth-element route fails for the tested family/claim.

falsification_tests.fail_condition: Success depends on choices that can only be justified after seeing the target answer.
falsification_tests.effect: Reject the proof path as hindsight-contaminated.

falsification_tests.fail_condition: A minimal instance violates a propagated obligation claimed universal.
falsification_tests.effect: Refute or restrict the relevant edge/claim; preserve the counterexample.

proof_ledgers.discovery_ledger: May contain coincidences, visual prompts, analogies, songs, dreams, metaphors, numerical mnemonics and speculative connections with provenance.
proof_ledgers.prediction_ledger: Contains frozen predictions/falsifiers created from discovery hints before target testing where possible.
proof_ledgers.evidence_ledger: Contains experimental observations, benchmark results, reconstructed models and counterexamples.
proof_ledgers.proof_ledger: Contains only formally discharged mathematical obligations and independently checkable certificates.

handoff_core.instruction: Apply this engine to the CURRENT TRUMP gate without resetting completed work.
handoff_core.first_question: WHAT EXACT TERMINAL CLAIM ARE WE TRYING TO EARN?
handoff_core.second_question: WHAT MUST ALREADY BE TRUE HERE IF THAT TERMINAL CLAIM IS EVER TO BE CERTIFIED?
handoff_core.third_question: WHAT IS THE PI INVARIANT OF THIS EDGE?
handoff_core.fifth_question: WHAT OBSERVATION WOULD PROVE THAT THIS BEAUTIFUL PATH IS WRONG?

semantic_seal.human_ru: Пусть будущее служит нам не оправданием судьбы, а формой вопроса. Мы фиксируем то, что произошло, позволяем неожиданному предлагать гипотезы, распространяем требования конечной цели назад и затем идём вперёд только по тем связям, которые несут доказательство.
semantic_seal.machine: FUTURE_AS_BOUNDARY -> BACKWARD_OBLIGATIONS -> PRESENT_TEST -> FORWARD_CERTIFIED_REPLAY; SERENDIPITY -> HYPOTHESIS_NOT_AUTHORITY; POST_HOC != PREDICTION; EVERYTHING_RECORDED_CAN_BE_INSPECTED, NOTHING_UNCERTIFIED_BECOMES_PROOF
